name: Polymarket
description: Prediction market on Polygon. Agents discover markets with the Gamma API, trade outcome shares through the off-chain CLOB (EIP-712-signed orders settled on-chain by the CTF Exchange contracts), read positions from the Data API, and split/merge/redeem outcome tokens against pUSD collateral directly on-chain.

contracts.name: ExchangeV3 (Polymarket Protocol V2 order book settlement)

offchainApis.name: CLOB API (order book and trading)
offchainApis.use: Public (no auth): GET /book?token_id= (tick_size, min_order_size, neg_risk, version), prices, midpoints. L1 auth (EIP-712 ClobAuth, domain {name 'ClobAuthDomain', version '1', chainId 137}, message {address, timestamp, nonce, message 'This message attests that I control the given wallet'}; headers POLY_ADDRESS, POLY_SIGNATURE, POLY_TIMESTAMP, POLY_NONCE): POST /auth/api-key to create or GET /auth/derive-api-key to derive {apiKey, secret, passphrase}. L2 auth (headers POLY_ADDRESS, POLY_API_KEY, POLY_PASSPHRASE, POLY_TIMESTAMP, POLY_SIGNATURE = urlsafe-base64 HMAC-SHA256 keyed by base64-decoded secret over timestamp+METHOD+path+body): POST /order (one signed order), POST /orders (1-15), DELETE /order {orderID}, DELETE /orders [ids], DELETE /cancel-market-orders {asset_id|market}, DELETE /cancel-all, GET /data/orders, GET /data/order/{id}, GET /data/trades, POST /v1/heartbeats (dead-man switch). Orders are EIP-712 'Order' structs signed with domain {name 'Polymarket CTF Exchange', chainId 137, version '2' + verifyingContract CTF Exchange (neg_risk false) or Neg Risk CTF Exchange (neg_risk true); version '3' + ExchangeV3 for v2 books}. Order types GTC, GTD (expiration >= 3 min ahead), FOK, FAK; optional postOnly. BUY: makerAmount = pUSD, takerAmount = shares (6-decimal ints); SELL reversed. Use the official SDK where possible.

offchainApis.name: Gamma API (markets and events metadata)
offchainApis.use: Discover markets: GET /events/keyset, /events/{id}, /events/slug/{slug}, /markets/keyset, /markets/{id}, /markets/slug/{slug}, /public-search?q=, /tags, /series, /sports. Params: closed, limit, after_cursor, tag_id, version (v1 CTF | v2). Market fields: conditionId, clobTokenIds (v1 YES/NO token ids, JSON string), positionIds (v2), version.

offchainApis.name: Data API (positions, activity, value)
offchainApis.use: Read a wallet's positions (GET /v2/positions?user=, status OPEN default), portfolio value (/v2/value?user=), activity (/v2/activity?user=), trades, approvals state (/v2/approvals?user=), price history, holders, open interest.

offchainApis.name: Bridge API (deposits/withdrawals from other chains)
offchainApis.use: POST /deposit returns per-chain deposit addresses (evm, svm, btc, tron) for a Polymarket wallet; funds are bridged and swapped into pUSD on Polygon. GET /supported-assets lists tokens and minimums; GET /status/{address} tracks progress. Withdraw and quote endpoints are documented in the bridge section.

offchainApis.name: Geoblock check
offchainApis.use: GET returns {blocked, ip, country, region}; check before placing orders on behalf of a user.

offchainApis.name: CLOB WebSocket
offchainApis.use: Public order book, price and market lifecycle updates (incl. tick_size_change). Authenticated per-account order/trade updates at wss://ws-subscriptions-clob.polymarket.com/ws/user.

offchainApis.name: Relayer API
offchainApis.use: Submit Polymarket wallet (proxy/safe/deposit wallet) transactions without holding POL for gas.

actions.name: find markets
actions.description: Search events/markets and get token ids
actions.how: GET https://gamma-api.polymarket.com/public-search?q=... or /markets/slug/{slug}; read conditionId, clobTokenIds (v1) or positionIds (v2), version; then GET https://clob.polymarket.com/book?token_id= for tick_size and neg_risk.

actions.name: get pUSD
actions.description: Fund the trading wallet with collateral
actions.how: USDC.e.approve(CollateralOnramp, amt) then CollateralOnramp.wrap(USDC.e, to, amt); or use the Bridge API deposit addresses from other chains (auto-wraps to pUSD).

actions.name: approve trading
actions.how: pUSD.approve(CTF Exchange / Neg Risk Exchange) for BUY; ConditionalTokens.setApprovalForAll(exchange, true) for SELL; for neg-risk markets also approve the Neg Risk Adapter 0xd91E80cF2E7be2e162c6513ceD06f1dD0dA35296 (pUSD and Conditional Tokens). For v2 books: pUSD.approve(ExchangeV3) and PositionManager.setApprovalForAll(ExchangeV3, true). Existing CTF approvals do not carry over to v2.

actions.name: place order
actions.how: Derive L2 API creds (L1 ClobAuth signature), build and EIP-712-sign an Order for the correct exchange domain, POST https://clob.polymarket.com/order with L2 headers and {order, owner: apiKey, orderType: GTC|GTD|FOK|FAK}.

actions.name: cancel order
actions.description: Cancel one, several or all orders
actions.how: DELETE https://clob.polymarket.com/order {orderID}, DELETE /orders, DELETE /cancel-market-orders, or DELETE /cancel-all, with L2 headers. On-chain emergency: exchange.pauseUser().

actions.name: read positions
actions.description: List a wallet's positions and value

actions.name: split / merge
actions.description: Mint or burn complete YES+NO sets
actions.how: v1 standard: CtfCollateralAdapter.splitPosition/mergePositions(pUSD, 0x0, conditionId, [1,2], amount); v1 neg-risk: NegRiskCtfCollateralAdapter (same signatures); v2: Router.split/merge(bytes31 conditionId, amount).

actions.name: redeem
actions.description: Claim pUSD for winning shares after resolution
actions.how: v1: CtfCollateralAdapter or NegRiskCtfCollateralAdapter .redeemPositions(pUSD, 0x0, conditionId, [1,2]) after ConditionalTokens.setApprovalForAll(adapter, true); v2: Router.redeem(conditionId, outcomeIndex, amount) after PositionManager.setApprovalForAll(Router, true).

actions.name: withdraw
actions.how: pUSD.approve(CollateralOfframp, amt) then CollateralOfframp.unwrap(USDC.e, to, amt); or use the Bridge API withdraw flow to other chains.

risks: Geographic restrictions (official geoblock docs, 'due to regulatory requirements and compliance with international sanctions'): fully blocked (frontend and API, no new or closing orders) in Iran, Syria, Cuba, North Korea, and Crimea/Donetsk/Luhansk; close-only on frontend AND API in many countries incl. United States, United Kingdom, France, Germany, Italy, Belgium, Poland, Australia, Singapore, Taiwan, Thailand, Russia, Brazil, Argentina, New Zealand, Canada (Ontario, Quebec, British Columbia, Alberta) and others; close-only on frontend only in Ireland, Japan, Netherlands, South Korea, Malta (sports). Check GET https://polymarket.com/api/geoblock before trading.

Polymarket migrated to pUSD collateral and Protocol V2: markets can be v1 (CTF) or v2 (PositionManager); they use different exchanges, EIP-712 domain versions ('2' vs '3'), approvals and split/merge contracts. Check the market's version and neg_risk before acting.
Orders priced off the current tick size are rejected; GTD orders expire one minute before their stated expiration.
Resolution relies on oracles (UMA Optimistic Oracle adapters, OracleAggregator); disputes can delay payouts.
Exchange contracts are operator-matched and admin-pausable; pUSD and USDC.e wrap/unwrap revert while paused.
pUSD is backed 1:1 by USDC per Polymarket, but it is a Polymarket-issued, upgradeable token with no external listing.
notes: All addresses are Polygon mainnet (137) from https://docs.polymarket.com/resources/contracts. The Polymarket/ctf-exchange-v2 GitHub README lists different addresses for CtfCollateralAdapter (0xADa100874d00e3331D00F2007a9c336a65009718) and NegRiskCtfCollateralAdapter (0xAdA200001000ef00D07553cEE7006808F895c6F1) than the docs; this file uses the docs' addresses, which the docs' positions guide also uses. The older v1 exchanges (e.g. Neg Risk CTF Exchange 0xC5d563A36AE78145C45a50134d48A1215220f80a in the neg-risk-ctf-adapter repo) are no longer listed in the docs. Exchange V2 removed fillOrder/fillOrders and nonce-based on-chain cancel; only the operator calls matchOrders. ExchangeV3 and AutoRedeemer ABIs were not confirmed, so no key functions are listed for them.
